ينضبط (form VII)
# يَنْضَبِطُ (yanḍabiṭu) /jan.dˤa.bi.tˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْضَبَطَ (inḍabaṭa)
# يَنْضَبِطَ (yanḍabiṭa) /jan.dˤa.bi.tˤa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْضَبَطَ (inḍabaṭa)
# يَنْضَبِطْ (yanḍabiṭ) /jan.dˤa.bitˤ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْضَبَطَ (inḍabaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
